content.heading: The networks and access around the building matter.
content.lead: Igloo Construction coordinates roads, utility networks and supporting site works so residential and mixed-use developments are ready for real use.
paragraphs: Our project record includes road and network works for the Staoueli villas, the Douaouda housing programme and other residential sites across the Algiers region.
Infrastructure is planned as part of the delivery: interfaces, sequencing and site readiness are coordinated with the buildings and public realm around them.
